mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fitian.Fcm_token(uid, device_id, token) VALUES (#{uid},#{device_id},#{token}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE token = VALUES(token)
INSERT INTO fitian.Fcm_token(uid, device_id, token) VALUES (#{uid},#{device_id},#{token}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE token = VALUES(token), is_active = 1, update_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT uid, device_id, token, update_at FROM fitian.Fcm_token WHERE uid = #{uid} AND is_active = 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM fitian.Fcm_token WHERE is_active = 0 AND update_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
